verdict.rationale: Finix documents seller payout management through the Dashboard and API, a payouts dashboard, and platform monetization with configurable fee schemas. It also offers more than 10 automated report types covering transactions, disputes and fees, which suggests some fee and transaction visibility. Nothing in the evidence describes a ledger view of balances per seller and per platform fee account, end-to-end tracing from charge through split to payout, or reconciliation tooling. Missing for 10: per-seller and platform fee-account balance views, charge-to-split-to-payout traceability, penny-level reconciliation docs, independent corroboration.
